boundary_probes.rationale: Decimal(3)*Decimal(0.1)=Decimal(0.3), equal to budget; no BUDGET-02.
Regular demand cannot be negative; this contract has no return events.
A negative procurement unit price cannot silently decrease the budget total.
Confirmed receipt quantity must be nonnegative; returns require a separate typed movement.
The supplied economics source must be retained rather than replaced with synthetic-profile.
Known multiple 5 can be honoured: ceil((280-69)/5)*5=215. Current output is provisional raw need211; approval remains blocked.
Known minimum10 can be honoured even if multiple is unknown. Current provisional need1 remains blocked; define contract explicitly.
Overdue80 is due day1: 280+80-70=290; day6 balance70-60-80=-70.
Past ETA without an updated future ETA cannot reduce need.
Start-of-day7 ordinary receipt precedes end-of-day7 demand, so there is no pre-ETA shortage.
Unknown price for a zero quantity does not consume budget.

Order110 arrives start day7; day18 ends at0; days19..27 lose10/day; existing100 arrives day28. 90 units cannot be served on time. Reference first_deficit_day8 is WITHOUT proposed order and is not itself erroneous. requires_expedite only covers d<lead_time; it is not a general certificate of feasible supply. Documentation does not explicitly require approval_blocked for timing gaps, so unblocked status alone is not declared a contract violation.
